text:
Maya Chen: Quick RFC follow-up  streaming v2->v3 migration. We agreed to remove chunked-EOF framing in v3. We need a pragmatic shim strategy for customers that still rely on EOF signals. Thoughts? :thinking:

Raj Patel: my priority is correctness for existing clients. suggest an ingress-side converter (edge proxy) that turns v3 framing into EOF-delimited chunks for older clients. low config surface.

Dave Liu: ingress converter ok but adds extra hop. worried about added latency on tail tokens for realtime flows. can we do it as an opt-in tenant-level shim behind a feature flag?

Maya Chen: yes opt-in makes sense. default = off. plan: 1) opt-in shim on tenant config 2) telemetry + error budget 3) canary to 5% tenants first.

Irene Gomez: telemetry: we need per-route token latency by percentile and a synthetic check that validates EOF semantics. cc @deploy-bot for canary automation.

Raj Patel: also consider a library shim (client-side) for OSS SDKs  simpler for PLG users. But not everyone updates SDKs. ingress shim covers those.

Dave Liu: library shim + ingress shim seems redundant but acceptable. get risk down by prioritizing ingress for enterprise tenants and pushing client shim in SDK patch releases.

Maya Chen: tradeoffs note: ingress shim increases p50/p95 slightly. client libs avoid server cost but rely on user upgrade. argue we support both and route by tenant plan.

Irene Gomez: rollout checklist proposal: feature-flag toggle, integration test harness (§stream-eof-suite), canary waves (1%, 5%, 25%, 100%), rollback plan, alerting on EOF-mismatch errors >0.1% and latency p95 increase >10%.

Raj Patel: config prototype for ingress shim: 
```json
{
  "tenant": "T123",
  "shim": { "mode": "eof-emulation", "enabled": true, "timeout_ms": 200 }
}
```

Dave Liu: small ops ask: for EOF-emulation we need to keep KV cache behavior identical. make sure we don't flush KV out-of-band when translating frames.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for streaming-shim v0.1 -> target tenants [T123, T456] (wave 1). build: infra/stream-shim:sha256:deadbeef. :rocket:

Maya Chen: capturing action items: - Raj: client SDK patch + docs - Dave: perf telem dashboard + KV validation tests - Irene: rollout playbook + alerts - Ops: watch canary wave and collect logs. will sync tomorrow 10am PT. :calendar:

Raj Patel: one more: add a lightweight compatibility header so downstream logs can easily filter shimmed requests: `X-Redwood-Shim: eof-emulation-v1`.

Irene Gomez: ack. also add a metric `shim.eof_emulation.per_tenant.success_rate` to the monitor set.

Maya Chen: thanks everyone. low-friction approach, keep the opt-in default. follow-ups in this thread.
